description: This source file provides utility functions for synchronizing and persisting files and JSON settings within the Utils namespace. It includes functions for file synchronization (syncPersistFile) and for persisting JSON settings to a file (persistJsonSettings).

methods.name: void syncPersistFile(const string file)
methods.description: Synchronizes the contents of the specified file by opening it, flushing buffered output, syncing to disk, and then closing it.

methods.name: void persistJsonSettings(const string strFile,const string strKey,const JsonValue & jsValue)
methods.description: Persists a JSON value associated with a key into a specified file, updating existing settings, and then synchronizes the file to disk.
